name: local-llm-router
description: Routes boilerplate/refactor sub-tasks to a local LLM (Exo, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or llama.cpp, auto-detected) instead of your cloud model, with usage tracking (GET /stats) showing estimated $ saved. If no local backend exists yet, assesses your hardware and helps you set one up. Includes daisy-chain for adding a device to an existing Exo cluster with one consolidated confirmation instead of per-step prompts. The local-model-specific half of hybrid-local-router, split out for anyone who wants local routing without the roadmap/grouping/handoff work-orchestration skills.
